extDescription.message: Move comments and description below the video and recommendations to the right. Restore the classic YouTube layout.

optionsIntro.message: Choose how restored video pages behave. Changes apply as you make them.

statusRestored.message: This page had the new layout. Classic layout restored.

statusClassic.message: This page already uses the classic layout. Nothing to change.

statusOther.message: Open a YouTube video to use this.

statusUnavailable.message: This works on YouTube video pages. If a video is already open, reload it once.

statusUnknown.message: YouTube changed something we don't recognise yet. Nothing was changed on this page.

statusOff.message: Classic layout is off. YouTube is showing its own layout.

statusPaused.message: Restoration is paused while a layout fix is prepared.

alreadyClassicInfo.message: Only pages with the new layout change.

hideAiHelp.message: Hide Ask and AI entry points on restored video pages. Normal search stays available.

spoilerHelp.message: Keep comments behind Show comments. Once opened, they stay open for this browser session.

widthHelp.message: Applies above 1920 pixels, outside theater and fullscreen modes.

optionsOff.message: Turn on Classic layout in the toolbar popup to use these options.

featureUnavailable.message: This option is temporarily unavailable while a fix is prepared.

saved.message: Saved. Open video pages update automatically.

saveFailed.message: The change could not be saved. Try again.

welcomeTitle.message: The familiar layout, back in place.

welcomeBody.message: Undo puts comments and description below the player and recommendations on the right when YouTube shows the new layout.

welcomeClassic.message: Already have the classic layout? Undo leaves it as it is.

welcomeSwitch.message: Use Classic layout in the toolbar popup to switch it off at any time. Alt+Shift+Y also toggles it.

privacyLine.message: No account, tracking or analytics. Settings stay in your browser profile.

notAffiliated.message: Not affiliated with YouTube or Google.

devNotice.message: Development build. Live layout and compatibility checks are still in progress.

reportPrivacy.message: These are the exact technical details included in your report. No video URL, title, account information or page content is included. Nothing is sent automatically.

reportNotConfigured.message: Report destinations will be connected when the public repository is ready. You can copy these details for now.

copyFailed.message: Select the report details and copy them manually.

rating.message: If this saved your YouTube, a rating helps others find it.
